title: Flower
description: One flower, described to the individual petal. Issue 1 — the only issue. Sealed by SHA-256; see SEAL.sha256 and COVENANT.md. Lengths are millimetres, angles are degrees, fractions run 0..1 from base to apex. Any vocabulary accepts an 'x:' term and any object accepts 'ext' and 'notes', so no future flower requires this file to change.

label.description: What this flower is called here.

source.description: Specimen, plate, publication, garden or imagination this record was taken from.

unit.description: What this record is. A daisy 'flower' is a pseudanthium whose apparent petals are whole ray florets.

florets.description: For a pseudanthium: the classes of true flowers composing it, outside inward.

merosity.description: Base number of parts per whorl (3-merous, 5-merous, …); 0 = indefinite.

bracts.description: Bracts, bracteoles, involucre, spathe, glumes, lemma, palea.

ovaryPosition.description: Ovary relative to the other parts.

whorls.description: Floral series from the outside inward. May be empty for naked flowers.

floralFormula.description: Conventional floral formula, e.g. '↯ K5 C5 A5 G(3)'.

extensionTerm.description: Any term outside the core vocabulary, prefixed 'x:'.

ext.description: Free-form extension space. The schema never inspects it.

measure.description: A length in millimetres: one value or a range.

count.description: A number of parts: exact, a range, or botanically indefinite (∞).

color.description: A colour. sRGB is mandatory so every colour is renderable; the rest refines it.

name.description: Colour word or chart reference (e.g. an RHS Colour Chart code).

ultraviolet.description: Behaviour under UV, as a pollinator sees it.

epidermis.description: Cell shape driving sheen and saturation.

from.description: Start along the organ axis, 0 base .. 1 apex.

to.description: End along the organ axis, 0 base .. 1 apex.

visibleIn.description: Spectrum in which the mark shows.

blade.description: A flattened, petal-like organ: sepal, petal, tepal, bract, corona segment, petaloid staminode.

outline.description: Planar outline of the flattened organ.

widestAt.description: Position of greatest width along the axis, 0 base .. 1 apex.

depth.description: Sinus depth as a fraction of the distance to the midrib/base.

claw.description: Narrow stalk-like base of a clawed petal.

longitudinalCurve.description: Bend along the axis, base to apex.

longitudinalCurveAngle.description: Total bend base to apex; positive = toward the floral axis.

transverseCurve.description: Bend across the axis, margin to margin.

twist.description: Rotation about the organ's own axis, base to apex.

elevation.description: Angle between the organ axis at its base and the floral axis: 0 = parallel to the axis (closed/erect), 90 = flat open, >90 = reflexed.

epidermis.description: Cell shape driving sheen and saturation.

adaxial.description: Inner / upper face (toward the floral axis).

epidermis.description: Cell shape driving sheen and saturation.

abaxial.description: Outer / lower face (away from the floral axis).

gradient.description: Ground colour along the axis; stops ordered base to apex.

attachment.description: How the anther joins the filament.

organ.description: One floral organ. Every field is optional so the same shape serves as a whorl prototype and as a per-member override.

member.description: One individual organ — the single petal, the single stamen.

index.description: 1-based position within the series, counted clockwise from azimuth 0 as seen from the front of the open flower.

azimuth.description: Degrees clockwise around the floral axis, seen from the front; 0 = adaxial (toward the stem / uppermost).

absent.description: true = this position is empty (abortion, reduction).

overrides.description: Deep-merged over the whorl prototype; a present key replaces the prototype's value, objects merge key by key, arrays replace whole.

whorl.description: One series of like organs. Series are listed from the outside of the flower inward.

organName.description: What one member is called here: sepal, petal, tepal, stamen, carpel, …

divergence.description: Angle between successive members for spiral insertion (≈137.5 for Fibonacci spirals).

offset.description: Azimuth of member 1 when members are not listed individually.

degree.description: Fusion among members of this series.

groups.description: Partial unions: bundles of stamens, lips of a corolla. Each group lists member indices.

prototype.description: The typical member of this series.

members.description: Individual organs. Omit when every member equals the prototype evenly spaced; list them when any differs — this is the resolution 'to the petal'.

flowerBody.description: The anatomy of a single flower at a single moment.

merosity.description: Base number of parts per whorl (3-merous, 5-merous, …); 0 = indefinite.

bracts.description: Bracts, bracteoles, involucre, spathe, glumes, lemma, palea.

ovaryPosition.description: Ovary relative to the other parts.

whorls.description: Floral series from the outside inward. May be empty for naked flowers.

floralFormula.description: Conventional floral formula, e.g. '↯ K5 C5 A5 G(3)'.
